translation: For internal use, take with ash-free wine (無灰酒); for external application, grind with tea brine (茶滷) and apply; avoid all raw, cold, and fermenting foods. <ins>Sanhuang Baola Wan</ins> (Three-Yellow Precious-Wax Pill, 三黃寶蠟丸) specifically treats all injuries from falls and blows, and tetanus (破傷風), and injuries that exhaust one into consumptive disease, and in women postpartum lochia that does not cease, giving rise to strange conditions, stagnant blood rushing to the heart, phlegm confusing the orifices of the heart, and danger at any moment. For severe cases take one qian, for mild cases three fen, with ash-free wine, and one is immediately restored to life.
